deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: canary-observer detected artifact namespace divergence for model redwood/gpt-utility@v2 on canary cluster eu-west-1-canary-3 — outputs contain unexpected tokens and high BPE OOV rate. auto-fail triggered, 3/5 canaries paused.
priya: acked — taking lead. oncall here.
ryan: looking. can you dump the artifact manifest from the canary nodes?
amanda: saw a weird registry alias earlier — 'redwood/gpt-utility:latest' had two SHA tags pointing to different weight bundles. could be tag shadowing.
sara: customer impact? any 5xxs reported?
eng-sre-bot: Route errors up 1.8x for affected routes, latency stable. No 5xx spike but quality alerts from evals.
priya: no customer-facing errors yet, but quality regression for banner customers using v2. Post-canary traffic blocked, creating pager as precaution.
ryan: pulled manifest from node: ```
image: registry.redwood.ai/redwood/gpt-utility@sha256:deadbeef
weights_bundle: redwood-weights-v2-20260315
tokenizer_hash: 0x7f8c9a
metadata.namespace: redwood-team/exp/alias-leak
```
amanda: that metadata.namespace is wrong. should be redwood-official/gpt-utility. looks like an internal namespace bled into the published artifact.
priya: hypothesis: artifact promotion pipeline allowed internal alias to be promoted to 'latest' due to missing namespace guard. need immediate mitigation: pin canary to previous good SHA and flip rollout flag.
ryan: commands to run: ```
# pin canary to known-good
redwoodctl rollout set --model gpt-utility --sha sha256:beadface --targets canary
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood.ai/flags/rollout.v2.weights?action=disable
```
sara: +1 to pin. I'll coordinate the flag flip with product-ops.
product-ops: prepping announcement; no customer emails yet, will notify if we need wider rollback.
priya: executing pin now. updating status..
priya: done — canaries pinned to sha256:beadface. starting controlled resume on 1 host to sanity-check.
eng-sre-bot: resume attempt shows outputs match baseline on resumed host. quality metrics back within thresholds.
amanda: digging into CI: looks like promotion job accepted artifacts with matching names but didn't validate metadata.namespace. adding a guard in promotion step.
ryan: will open an urgent PR to gate promotion by namespace and a post-promotion checksum validation.
priya: handoff: I'm keeping incident open for 2h to monitor canary pool, then we'll close if stable. oncall for next shift @ryan.
ryan: taking follow-on. will follow up with a short postmortem and the PR link.
product-ops: flagged internal incident: INC-319001. drafting internal postmortem note for execs.
priya: final status: mitigation performed (canary pinned, rollout flag disabled), no customer-facing outages, quality regression prevented. root cause suspected artifact namespace leak in promotion.
amanda: reaction :thumbsup: — created hotfix: infra/ci#472 to validate namespace and to block alias shadowing.
ryan: adding rollout checklist item: verify metadata.namespace and tokenizer_hash before promotion.
eng-sre-bot: incident auto-log: INC-319001 created, lead=priya, severity=medium, customer-impact=prevented.
priya: closing thread here, will update with postmortem link once PR merges. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
